scope: MEAS: independent checks/report, published note/bar-map, source, actual sheet and visual review; not aural review.

defects.location: docs/assets/data/ravel-quartet-scherzo/sheet/p1.svg, p4.svg, p6.svg, p9.svg; MusicXML-to-LilyPond ornament endpoint conversion
defects.finding: The Violin I trill beginning in bar 9 visibly continues across all inspected pages through bar 198, including subsequent lyrical and pizzicato material. Viola trill extensions likewise leak through the ending. Selected source XML does encode eight stop elements, several on non-printing playback auxiliaries; those endpoints must not be discarded with the auxiliary attacks.
defects.requiredFix: Preserve each source-owned wavy-line stop at the END of its carrier note/rest, route it to its matching part/spanner number, and order a stop before any next start at the same instant. Keep the hidden auxiliary attacks excluded from the canonical musical event table. Re-engrave all nine pages; do not hide ornaments wholesale or suppress the erroneous lines with styling. Preserve the four-part note/bar identities and disclose the notation repair.

defects.location: Selected XML P3 trill number 1 beginning in bar 176
defects.finding: The selected source contains four viola trill starts but only three stops. The author’s endpoint audit identifies the unresolved C-sharp5 start in bar 176; its correct end is not yet established in the XML.
defects.requiredFix: Recover the exact intended endpoint from the native OpenScore MSCX spanner duration or a corresponding printed source, open and record that evidence, then apply a guarded, documented closure at that exact musical position. Do not invent a convenient end or remove the trill. If the endpoint cannot be established, withhold/unpublish score.json and sheet/ rather than approve the false indefinite ornament.

report.finding: Numerical gates, source attack/tie/tuplet repairs and published 198-bar/four-part pack agree with checks. The report’s timing-inspection claims do not clear the independently observed engraving defects. It must record their source-faithful repair before a pass.

barMap.finding: All 3876 published note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and bar times strictly increase. Actual SVG/index sets are exactly 1–198. Pages 1, 4, 6 and 9 were rendered and inspected, including the crossvoice tie at 88–89, 18:8 viola tuplets at 120–123, final cadence and erroneous continuous trill lines.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified in these current timing windows. The q591 pre-final constraint now keeps the upper run/chord before its written pause; the genuine final attack is retained near 346.544 s. Quiet 152–160 s contours remain coherent despite a 10 s global-detector disagreement. Those observations neither validate false printed ornaments nor establish uniformly precise onsets. The interior constraint is fitting information, not independent validation.

source.edition: OpenScore String Quartets; transcription references IMSLP #335585
source.finding: Opened repository licensing, exact archive and catalogue; selected XML attribution also identifies the transcriber and referenced scan. The removed original scan was not independently opened.

version.finding: Movement II, 1–198 once, four original string parts, no inserted traversal. Timing/order are coherent in inspected windows, but the printed ornament version is currently wrong and prevents acceptance.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check performed by VerS. Numeric/source-attack proof alone is not engraving validation.
